_comment_purpose: v4 thesis sweep — TRUE 3-axis factorial dispatched as a single sweep. Probes the formalism bridge end-to-end: Initial_Nutrients ▢ × Temperature_K ▢ × Sigma_halflife_min ▢ all flow through evt_init_kinetics → ◇ kinetic scalars → Φ. Each axis isolates one of the three new mechanisms in v4.
_comment_accept: PASS if (a) ATP+ADP within ±5% of 5995 across ALL 12 conditions (mass conservation); (b) σE endpoint < 1500 in all 30-min-halflife conditions, > 5000 in all 600-min-halflife conditions (decay scaling); (c) ATP basin floor at T=310.15 reproduces v3's 2.24±0.21 mM in the Nut sweep; (d) at T=320.15 the basin floor shifts upward by ~Q10 factor (Q10≈2 ⇒ ~2× regen flux); (e) all three axes show monotone separation in their primary readout.
_comment_horizon: 21600 s = 360 min — same as v3 run_20260509_125201 for direct comparability with deep_analysis_v3 baselines.
_comment_scope: 3 × 2 × 3 = 18 conditions × 16 replicates = 288 runs. Single dispatch. On remote-gpu with workers ≤ 18, runs as condition-batch GPU mode.

parameters._axis: A. Dose-response — drives Nutrients ⬡ via evt_apply_initial_nutrients at t=0
B. Q10 thermal — drives k_thermo_factor ◇ via evt_init_kinetics; Q10=2 ⇒ ratio ≈ 2.0
C. Sigma decay — drives k_sigma_decay ◇ via evt_init_kinetics; 30/120/600 spans 20× rate range with the model default (120) as a v3-comparable anchor
